description: Software emulation of the MOS 6502 CPU and the C64 SID sound chip for SharpKind-based games.

Cryptanalysis of the SharpKind classical ciphers: Caesar by letter frequencies, monoalphabetic substitution by an English quadgram hill climb, and homophonic substitution by an English or Italian quadgram hill climb.

ROCm-accelerated ONNX Runtime native libraries for Linux x64 (AMD GPU) using MIGraphX Execution Provider. Drop-in replacement for the CPU-only libonnxruntime.so shipped by Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime. Provides AMD GPU acceleration via ROCm/MIGraphX without requiring consumers to compile from source.
Source control UI building blocks: unified diff editor, diff lines and data grid behaviors

Firebase Cloud Messaging sender: notification and data-only pushes to device tokens, topic sends and topic subscriptions, with a result per token that says whether the token is invalid or the push provider credentials are broken.
Host-neutral classic Sudoku boards, solving, generation, and difficulty analysis.

A document engine with no third-party dependencies: JSON templates and data kept apart, laid out into PDF (PDF/A-3B, PDF/UA-1, Factur-X, fillable forms) or SVG, with its own font measuring, barcodes and template checks.

Reads one page out of an existing PDF and hands it to Frisket, which lays it out like a picture and writes it as a Form XObject. A copy, not a rendering: the page's marks and resources travel as they are.

The typefaces Frisket draws with when it is given none: Mulish, the default, then Elms Sans, Noto Sans Display and Glametrix - embedded, each under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, with its licence text.

The Roslyn source generator for Bit.BlazeDb: turns [BlazeDbTable] types into table descriptors with binary row and key serializers, key extractors and typed index definitions, with no runtime reflection.
IndexedDB storage for bit Bsqlite, using wa-sqlite's IDBBatchAtomicVFS: persistent, async-capable (JSPI or Asyncify), and available where OPFS is not.
OPFS storage for bit Bsqlite, using wa-sqlite's OPFSCoopSyncVFS: persistent, multi-connection, worker-only and without COOP/COEP headers.
Cache Storage for bit Bsqlite: block-based and journal-committed, and the migration path off Bit.Besql - a database Bit.Besql left in Cache Storage is imported losslessly on first open.
Optional SkiaSharp image helpers for JRK.JevRunner. Render normalized Jev bounding-box answers as customizable outlines and return PNG bytes without modifying the source image.
